## Overview

This site is written in Markdown (`.qmd` files) and rendered to static HTML by
[Quarto](https://quarto.org). Every push to `main` triggers a GitHub Actions workflow
that runs `quarto render` and publishes the `_site/` folder to GitHub Pages.

## How the project cards work

The Projects page is a Quarto [listing](https://quarto.org/docs/websites/website-listings.html)
over `projects/*/index.qmd`. A small custom EJS template (`projects.ejs`) turns each page's
front matter into a card, adding buttons for the custom `github` and `demo` fields.
